{{recipe}}

If you think '''vanilla fudge''' is good, wait until you try this fancy [[Cookbook:Fudge|fudge]] recipe.

== Ingredients ==
*2½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*1 can (5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Condensed Milk|evaporated milk]]
*2 cups [[Cookbook:Marshmallow Creme|marshmallow crème]]
*8 oz [[Cookbook:White Chocolate|white chocolate]]
*¾ cup [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Pecan|pecan]] nuts
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract

== Procedure ==
#Line a [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking tray]] with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] (extending it beyond the tray), and grease it up with some butter.
#In the [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], combine the sugar, milk, and butter.
#Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over medium heat, stirring constantly.
#Cook for 5 minutes after reaching the boiling point, stirring the mixture constantly so it doesn’t burn.
#Remove it from the heat.
#Add the marshmallow crème, white chocolate, pecans, and the vanilla extract. Stir the mixture until smooth.
#Pour into the tray, and leave to cool to room temperature.
#Refrigerate until firm, then cut into pieces.
#Enjoy!
